instruction: Studio photograph, full shot, high angle. In a minimalist white studio, the dancer in the white outfit (R2) on the left leans forward with one arm extended, while the dancer in the black outfit (R1) on the right stands tall, leaning back with one arm raised high. They pose back-to-back without touching, executing sharp, angular contemporary dance movements. Bright, clean studio lighting casts soft, distinct shadows on the white floor, emphasizing the high-contrast black and white palette.
elements: R1 stands tall while leaning back with one arm raised high
R2 leans forward with one arm extended
R1 and R2 pose back-to-back without touching
R1 and R2 execute sharp angular contemporary dance movements
